```plato
    //==
    // # Quadrics

    // z = (x / a)^2 - (y / b)^2, with (x, y) sweeping Domain.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paraboloid
    Eval(s: HyperbolicParaboloid, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var x = s.Domain.Min.X.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.X, uv.U);
        var y = s.Domain.Min.Y.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.Y, uv.V);
        return (x, y, (x / s.SemiAxes.X).Square - (y / s.SemiAxes.Y).Square);
    }
```

```plato
    // (a cosh t cos u, b cosh t sin u, c sinh t): U one full lap, V over
    // ParameterRange. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyperboloid
    Eval(s: HyperboloidOfOneSheet, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var around = uv.U.Turns;
        var t = s.ParameterRange.Lerp(uv.V);
        return (s.SemiAxes.X * t.Angle.Cosh * around.Cos,
                s.SemiAxes.Y * t.Angle.Cosh * around.Sin,
                s.SemiAxes.Z * t.Angle.Sinh);
    }
```

```plato
    // (a sinh t cos u, b sinh t sin u, c cosh t): the +Z sheet only, so a
    // ParameterRange starting at 0 starts at the sheet's apex.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyperboloid
    Eval(s: HyperboloidOfTwoSheets, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var around = uv.U.Turns;
        var t = s.ParameterRange.Lerp(uv.V);
        return (s.SemiAxes.X * t.Angle.Sinh * around.Cos,
                s.SemiAxes.Y * t.Angle.Sinh * around.Sin,
                s.SemiAxes.Z * t.Angle.Cosh);
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Classical surfaces of revolution

    // r = WaistRadius cosh(z / WaistRadius), with z over ParameterRange.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catenoid
    Eval(s: Catenoid, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var around = uv.U.Turns;
        var z = s.ParameterRange.Lerp(uv.V);
        var r = s.WaistRadius * (z / s.WaistRadius).Angle.Cosh;
        return (r * around.Cos, r * around.Sin, z);
    }
```

```plato
    // A ray through the axis swept TurnCount turns while rising Pitch per turn:
    // U the sweep, V the distance out along the ray.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helicoid
    Eval(s: Helicoid, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var turns = uv.U * s.TurnCount;
        var around = turns.Turns;
        var r = s.Radii.Lerp(uv.V);
        return (r * around.Cos, r * around.Sin, s.Pitch * turns);
    }
```

```plato
    // The tractrix revolved: r = Radius / cosh t, z = Radius (t - tanh t), with
    // t over ParameterRange. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pseudosphere
    Eval(s: Pseudosphere, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var around = uv.U.Turns;
        var t = s.ParameterRange.Lerp(uv.V);
        var r = s.Radius / t.Angle.Cosh;
        return (r * around.Cos, r * around.Sin, s.Radius * (t - t.Angle.Tanh));
    }
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Evaluating the superquadric and shell surfaces
    //
    // The spherical products and the two placed families. The superquadric
    // formulas differ from the ellipsoid and torus only by raising each sinusoid
    // to an exponent, which is why every one of them goes through SignedPower:
    // the sinusoid is negative over half its range and a fractional exponent of a
    // negative base is not real.

    //==
    // # Superquadrics

    // Barr's spherical product: U the longitude over a full lap, V the latitude
    // from the south pole to the north.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superellipsoid
    Eval(s: Superellipsoid, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var longitude = uv.U.Turns;
        var latitude = ((uv.V - 0.5) * 0.5).Turns;
        var ring = SignedPower(latitude.Cos, s.LatitudeExponent);
        return (s.SemiAxes.X * ring * SignedPower(longitude.Cos, s.LongitudeExponent),
                s.SemiAxes.Y * ring * SignedPower(longitude.Sin, s.LongitudeExponent),
                s.SemiAxes.Z * SignedPower(latitude.Sin, s.LatitudeExponent));
    }
```

```plato
    // The superelliptical section carried around the superelliptical ring:
    // U around the ring, V around the section.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superquadrics
    Eval(s: Supertoroid, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var around = uv.U.Turns;
        var section = uv.V.Turns;
        var ring = s.MajorRadius + s.MinorRadius * SignedPower(section.Cos, s.SectionExponent);
        return (ring * SignedPower(around.Cos, s.RingExponent),
                ring * SignedPower(around.Sin, s.RingExponent),
                s.MinorRadius * SignedPower(section.Sin, s.SectionExponent));
    }
```

```plato
    // The spherical product of the two superformula radii, each read through the
    // plane curve's own RadiusAt. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superformula
    Eval(s: Superformula3D, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var longitude = uv.U.Turns;
        var latitude = ((uv.V - 0.5) * 0.5).Turns;
        var ring = s.Latitudinal.RadiusAt(latitude);
        var sweep = s.Longitudinal.RadiusAt(longitude);
        return (sweep * longitude.Cos * ring * latitude.Cos,
                sweep * longitude.Sin * ring * latitude.Cos,
                ring * latitude.Sin);
    }
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Blend and growth surfaces

    // The ring cyclide with a = MajorRadius, b = MinorRadius, d = Offset and
    // c = sqrt(a^2 - b^2), every parameter line a circle. The shared denominator
    // a - c cos u cos v is non-zero exactly when a > c, which the type's
    // a > b > 0 precondition guarantees.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dupin_cyclide
    Eval(s: DupinCyclide, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var u = uv.U.Turns;
        var v = uv.V.Turns;
        var a = s.MajorRadius;
        var b = s.MinorRadius;
        var d = s.Offset;
        var c = (a * a - b * b).Sqrt;
        var denominator = a - c * u.Cos * v.Cos;
        return ((d * denominator + b * b * u.Cos) / denominator,
                b * u.Sin * (a - d * v.Cos) / denominator,
                b * v.Sin * (c * u.Cos - d) / denominator);
    }
```

```plato
    // A circular section carried around a tapering spiral: U around the section,
    // V along the whorls, with the section shrinking to nothing at V = 1.
    // https://mathworld.wolfram.com/SeashellSurface.html
    Eval(s: SeashellSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var section = uv.U.Turns;
        var spiral = (uv.V * s.TurnCount).Turns;
        var taper = 1.0 - uv.V;
        var r = s.InnerRadius + s.TubeRadius * taper * (1.0 + section.Cos);
        return (r * spiral.Cos,
                r * spiral.Sin,
                s.Height * uv.V + s.TubeRadius * taper * section.Sin);
    }
```

## Line 223

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/surfaces-shapes.library.plato, line 223](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/surfaces-shapes.library.plato#L223).

```plato

    // r = sin(f0 phi)^e0 + cos(f1 phi)^e1 + sin(f2 theta)^e2 + cos(f3 theta)^e3,
    // with theta the longitude over a full lap and phi the inclination from pole
    // to pole; the radius scales the unit sphere direction.
    // https://paulbourke.net/geometry/sphericalh/
    Eval(s: SphericalHarmonicSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var theta = uv.U.Turns;
        var phi = (uv.V * 0.5).Turns;
        var r = SignedPower((phi * s.Frequencies.X).Sin, s.Exponents.X)
              + SignedPower((phi * s.Frequencies.Y).Cos, s.Exponents.Y)
              + SignedPower((theta * s.Frequencies.Z).Sin, s.Exponents.Z)
              + SignedPower((theta * s.Frequencies.W).Cos, s.Exponents.W);
        return (SpherePoint(theta, phi) * r).ToPoint;
    }
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Evaluating the non-orientable and self-intersecting surfaces
    //
    // Each body is the standard immersion of its surface. The self-intersections
    // are in the image, not in the parameterization: every one of these maps is
    // continuous and, except at the pinch points that the cross-cap and Whitney's
    // umbrella are defined by, an immersion.

    //==
    // # One-sided surfaces

    // The figure-eight immersion: the section turns a half turn over the lap, so
    // the ring closes onto itself reversed.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Klein_bottle
    Eval(s: KleinBottle, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var lap = uv.U.Turns;
        var half = (uv.U * 0.5).Turns;
        var section = uv.V.Turns;
        var figureEight = half.Cos * section.Sin - half.Sin * (section * 2.0).Sin;
        var ring = s.Radius + s.TubeRadius * figureEight;
        return (ring * lap.Cos,
                ring * lap.Sin,
                s.TubeRadius * (half.Sin * section.Sin + half.Cos * (section * 2.0).Sin));
    }
```

```plato
    // The sphere of radius 1 pushed through (x, y, z) -> Scale (y z, z x, x y).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_surface
    Eval(s: RomanSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var p = SpherePoint(uv.U.Turns, (uv.V * 0.5).Turns);
        return (s.Scale * p.Y * p.Z, s.Scale * p.Z * p.X, s.Scale * p.X * p.Y);
    }
```

```plato
    // (cos u sin 2v, sin u sin 2v, cos^2 v - cos^2 u sin^2 v) scaled by Radius:
    // U one full lap, V a quarter turn from the rim to the pinch line.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross-cap
    Eval(s: CrossCap, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var u = uv.U.Turns;
        var v = (uv.V * 0.25).Turns;
```

## Line 293

```plato
    // Apery's parameterization, with both parameters over a half turn and the
    // shared denominator 2 - sqrt 2 sin 3u sin 2v, which never vanishes.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boy%27s_surface
    Eval(s: BoySurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var u = (uv.U * 0.5).Turns;
        var v = (uv.V * 0.5).Turns;
        var root2 = 2.0.Sqrt;
        var denominator = 2.0 - root2 * (u * 3.0).Sin * (v * 2.0).Sin;
        return (s.Scale * (root2 * (u * 2.0).Cos * v.Cos * v.Cos + u.Cos * (v * 2.0).Sin) / denominator,
                s.Scale * (root2 * (u * 2.0).Sin * v.Cos * v.Cos - u.Sin * (v * 2.0).Sin) / denominator,
                s.Scale * 3.0 * v.Cos * v.Cos / denominator);
    }
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Self-intersecting patches

    // (u v, u, v^2) with (u, v) sweeping Domain. A Domain straddling u = 0 is
    // what makes the self-intersection and the pinch point visible.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whitney_umbrella
    Eval(s: WhitneyUmbrella, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var u = s.Domain.Min.X.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.X, uv.U);
        var v = s.Domain.Min.Y.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.Y, uv.V);
        return (u * v, u, v * v);
    }
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Evaluating the minimal and pseudospherical surfaces
    //
    // These are patches cut from unbounded parameterizations, so each body maps
    // the unit square onto the type's own `Domain` or interval and evaluates the
    // textbook formula there. The three surfaces whose formula contains
    // `ln tan(v / 2)` or `ln cos` state the matching precondition on their type;
    // no body clamps, because clamping would silently move the patch rather than
    // report the mistake.

    //==
    // # Minimal surfaces

    // (u - u^3/3 + u v^2, v - v^3/3 + v u^2, u^2 - v^2) over Domain.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enneper_surface
    Eval(s: EnneperSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var u = s.Domain.Min.X.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.X, uv.U);
        var v = s.Domain.Min.Y.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.Y, uv.V);
        return (s.Scale * (u - u * u * u / 3.0 + u * v * v),
                s.Scale * (v - v * v * v / 3.0 + v * u * u),
                s.Scale * (u * u - v * v));
    }
```

## Line 379

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/surfaces-shapes.library.plato, line 379](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/surfaces-shapes.library.plato#L379).

```plato

    // z = Scale ln(cos(y / Scale) / cos(x / Scale)), written as the difference of
    // the two logarithms. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scherk_surface
    Eval(s: ScherkSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var x = s.Domain.Min.X.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.X, uv.U);
        var y = s.Domain.Min.Y.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.Y, uv.V);
        return (x, y, s.Scale * ((y / s.Scale).Angle.Cos.NaturalLog
                                 - (x / s.Scale).Angle.Cos.NaturalLog));
    }
```

```plato
    // (2 sinh u cos v - 2/3 sinh 3u cos 3v, 2 sinh u sin v + 2/3 sinh 3u sin 3v,
    //  2 cosh 2u cos 2v) over Domain.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Henneberg_surface
    Eval(s: HennebergSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var u = s.Domain.Min.X.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.X, uv.U);
        var v = s.Domain.Min.Y.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.Y, uv.V).Angle;
        return (s.Scale * (2.0 * u.Angle.Sinh * v.Cos
                           - 2.0 / 3.0 * (u * 3.0).Angle.Sinh * (v * 3.0).Cos),
                s.Scale * (2.0 * u.Angle.Sinh * v.Sin
                           + 2.0 / 3.0 * (u * 3.0).Angle.Sinh * (v * 3.0).Sin),
                s.Scale * 2.0 * (u * 2.0).Angle.Cosh * (v * 2.0).Cos);
    }
```

```plato
    // (u - sin u cosh v, 1 - cos u cosh v, 4 sin(u/2) sinh(v/2)) over Domain: the
    // cycloid it contains is the V = 0 parameter line.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catalan%27s_minimal_surface
    Eval(s: CatalanSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var u = s.Domain.Min.X.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.X, uv.U);
        var v = s.Domain.Min.Y.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.Y, uv.V);
        return (s.Scale * (u - u.Angle.Sin * v.Angle.Cosh),
                s.Scale * (1.0 - u.Angle.Cos * v.Angle.Cosh),
                s.Scale * 4.0 * (u / 2.0).Angle.Sin * (v / 2.0).Angle.Sinh);
```

```plato
    // z = Scale (x^3 - 3 x y^2) over Domain — the real part of the cube of
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Pseudospherical surfaces

    // The tractrix profile revolved while rising Twist per turn: U sweeps
    // TurnCount turns, V the profile interval Inclinations.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dini%27s_surface
    Eval(s: DiniSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var turns = uv.U * s.TurnCount;
        var u = turns.Turns;
        var v = s.Inclinations.Lerp(uv.V);
        return (s.Radius * u.Cos * v.Sin,
                s.Radius * u.Sin * v.Sin,
                s.Radius * (v.Cos + (v / 2.0).Tan.NaturalLog) + s.Twist * turns);
    }
```

```plato
    // With d = 1 + u^2 sin^2 v: (2 (cos u + u sin u) sin v / d,
    // 2 (sin u - u cos u) sin v / d, ln tan(v/2) + 2 cos v / d).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kuen_surface
    Eval(s: KuenSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var u = s.ParameterRange.Lerp(uv.U);
        var v = s.Inclinations.Lerp(uv.V);
        var d = 1.0 + u * u * v.Sin * v.Sin;
        return (s.Scale * 2.0 * (u.Angle.Cos + u * u.Angle.Sin) * v.Sin / d,
                s.Scale * 2.0 * (u.Angle.Sin - u * u.Angle.Cos) * v.Sin / d,
                s.Scale * ((v / 2.0).Tan.NaturalLog + 2.0 * v.Cos / d));
    }
```

## Line 462

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/surfaces-shapes.library.plato, line 462](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/surfaces-shapes.library.plato#L462).

```plato
    // The sine-Gordon breather with b = Wavenumber and w = sqrt(1 - b^2), over
    // Domain. The denominator b ((w cosh b u)^2 + (b sin w v)^2) vanishes only
    // where cosh and sin are both zero, which cannot happen.
    // https://mathworld.wolfram.com/BreatherSurface.html
    Eval(s: BreatherSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D {
        var u = s.Domain.Min.X.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.X, uv.U);
        var v = s.Domain.Min.Y.Lerp(s.Domain.Max.Y, uv.V);
        var b = s.Wavenumber;
        var w = (1.0 - b * b).Sqrt;
        var bu = (b * u).Angle;
        var wv = (w * v).Angle;
        var vAngle = v.Angle;
        var denominator = b * (w * bu.Cosh * (w * bu.Cosh) + b * wv.Sin * (b * wv.Sin));
        return (-u + 2.0 * w * w * bu.Cosh * bu.Sinh / denominator,
                2.0 * w * bu.Cosh * (-w * vAngle.Cos * wv.Cos - vAngle.Sin * wv.Sin) / denominator,
                2.0 * w * bu.Cosh * (-w * vAngle.Sin * wv.Cos + vAngle.Cos * wv.Sin) / denominator);
    }
```
